meta.source: Sport England Active Places (ArcGIS feature services GIS_Active_Places_Power_Sites and GIS_Active_Places_Power_Facility)
meta.licence_checked: licenseInfo of the Active Places Power site and of each feature service, 2026-10-03: "Use of data made available through Sport England's Active Places ... is licensed under CC BY 4.0"; personal data is excluded from the licence
meta.method: Two site queries (postcode LIKE 'E14%'; envelope = the registry box), then the facilities of those sites in batches of 100 site ids. lat/long, easting/northing, UPRN and TOID come from the source.
fields_dropped: title, first name, surname, job title (site contact person)
meta.membership: in_box: the source coordinate lies in the box, or (no source coordinate) the ONSPD centre of the postcode does; in_e14: postcode district E14. Kept: either.
